target_window.tail: NO_NEW_ENTRIES_LAST40_SESSIONS; retain any unexecutable exit at end with marked exposure

rules.sector_ranking: fixed member equalweight mean20session return; complete membership prices required; select top2 strictly positive sectors; tie sector_id
rules.stock_ranking: within selected sector descending20session return relative to same fixed basket; ties symbol
rules.timing: close>prior20high breakout OR close>SMA20 and low<=SMA20 pullback, close>previousclose; nextsession open only expiry1session
rules.entry: 20session simple ATR true-range average, stopentryfill-2ATR; positive stop required; <=1%NAV loss+buy/sell costs/slippage; validlot floor. Volume<=1% prior20median sharevolume and <=1% current sessionvolume; latter is conservative execution feasibility, never decision feature.
rules.exits: close<=fixedentryStop OR close<SMA20 OR held20sessions and close<=entryprice OR held40sessions; next executableopen. T+1.
rules.same_day_cash: SELL_FIRST_THEN_BUY; same-day sales fund buys, not bankwithdrawals; no same-symbol rebuy
rules.daily_ambiguity: No intraday stop. Reject limit-bound/locked or invalidslipped executions; halt/missingbar cannotfill; failedsell carriesposition+pendingexit
rules.actions: NONE only when evidenced; any unsupported action blocks run, never silentlyignore
rules.calendar: explicitcomplete exchange sessions; no synthesized weekdays
rules.historical_input: require per-cutoff source/version/available_at proof and licensedhistoricalpurpose; todayfinancials forbidden

cost_limitations: Commission all-in includes exchange/regulatory fees; transfer and stamp separate. Rates not actualaccount. HALF_EVEN deliberately reuses pure WaveF arithmetic, not native ledger rounding change. Transfer reviewed against official government reproduction; specific effective-period evidence still required by admission.
